records.title: Intensive First-year Swedish
records.text: SWED 150 Intensive First-year Swedish (15) Fundamentals of oral and written Swedish. Intensive practice in speaking, reading, and writing. Interactive classroom, computer-assisted learning, language and reading laboratories. Emphasis on contemporary Swedish culture and society. If Swedish is the student's language of admission, only 10 credits count towards graduation. Maximum 15 credits allowed between SWED 101; SWED 102; SWED 103; and SWED 150.
